title: Trying to open another rpg maker Mv using rpg maker xp

posts.author: rpgmakernoobxp
posts.body: Hello, It is a pleasure this is my first time on this forum but I am trying to see if there is a script I can use to open rpg maker mv using rpg maker xp,any information would be appreciated, thank you!

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
no
XP and MV are based on different programming languages and have absolutely no compatibility to each other.

- Your profile currently says your first language is English, which does not appear to be correct. If you change that to be correct (or leave it blank), it will help others accommodate you.

You may want to do some tutorials on Windows, or something? As a rule, an editor can open the kinds of files that it's made to work with.
An editor (like RPG Maker) can't "open another program," and RPG Maker XP would only open RPG Maker XP projects that you've made.
There are some exceptions, like multiple companies make editors to open word documents or image files; but for anything more specific, that's it. It opens what it's designed to edit.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Well, you can use XP to open your XP project and use MV to open your MV project at the same time and copy and paste text between them.
But I don't know of any way to convert event commands or anything like that.
